item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:55 PM 16 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(Ragay, Minalabac, Pasacao, SanFernando, Bula, Tinambac, Siruma, Goa, Lagonoy, DelGallego, Balatan, Nabua, Buhi, Bato), #Albay(Tiwi, Libon, Polangui, Malinao, Oas), #Catanduanes(SanMiguel, Virac, Bagamanoc, Panganiban, Viga), #NorthernSamar(Mondragon, SilvinoLobos, LasNavas, Catubig, Palapag, Mapanas, Gamay, Lapinig), #Masbate(Balud, Uson, Cawayan), #CamarinesNorte(SanLorenzoRuiz, SanVicente, Talisay, Daet and Basud) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Lupi, Cabusao, Calabanga, Bombon, Magarao, Gainza, NagaCity, Ocampo, Pili, Milaor, Canaman, Pamplona, Tigaon, SanJose, Presentacion, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Baao, Sagñay, IrigaCity, Sipocot, Libmanan), #Catanduanes(SanAndres, Caramoran, Pandan), #NorthernSamar(SanRoque, Pambujan, Laoang), #Masbate(Aroroy, Baleno, CityOfMasbate, Milagros, Mandaon, Mobo) and #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
